info.title: Trema API
info.description:
The public REST API for Trema, the AI agent your company owns.

## Authentication

The API accepts two kinds of credentials:

- **Session cookie** — for browsers and interactive clients. Sign in through the auth endpoints under `/api/auth/*` to receive the session cookie. Organization-scoped operations act as the signed-in member of the active organization.
- **Service credential** — for machines. An administrator creates one with `POST /service-credentials` and receives the secret once. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer trema_sc_...`. The token acts as the principal it is bound to.

Each operation lists the scheme it accepts. Operations that list no scheme are public.

post.description: The one write seam for conversational input, under either auth mode. A service credential names any bound location; a browser session posts to its own web location, stamped server-side. A message lands on the thread: an active run absorbs it, otherwise a new run starts. A resolve decides a blocking elicitation, a stop cancels an active run, a retry re-runs a failed one, and feedback is recorded as an audit fact. The response reports the durably recorded classification and never waits for execution: observe progress through the run's event stream.

conversationId.description: The conversation the messages landed on.

scopeId.description: The scope the conversation belongs to.

threadRef.description: The thread within the location. Empty when the surface reported none.

updated.description: How many stored messages the batch edited.

unchanged.description: How many messages were already stored as reported.

deleted.description: How many stored messages the batch removed.

notFound.description: How many deletions named a message that was not stored.

messageCount.description: How many messages the conversation holds after the batch.

lastActivityAt.description: The conversation's latest activity. An ISO 8601 date-time.

seq.description: The message's place in the thread. Null when there was nothing to act on.

results.description: One result per reported message, in the order reported.

schema.description: What the batch did to the conversation.

get.summary: Liveness check over the API surface
get.description: Confirm the API is reachable and read the server's current time.

ok.description: Always true when the API is reachable.

time.description: The server's current time. An ISO 8601 date-time.

schema.description: The liveness status and the server's current time.

get.description: List the catalog of integration-backed surfaces and their availability.

id.description: The surface's stable identifier.

name.description: The surface's display name.

status.description: Whether the surface is planned or available through an installed integration.

builtIn.description: Whether the surface ships with the deployment instead of arriving with an installed integration.

locationBindable.description: Whether the surface's locations can be bound to a scope. A surface that is not location-bindable resolves implicitly and has nothing to pick: web chat is one location per member, resolving to that member's personal scope.

items.description: A surface that can carry conversations, and how its locations reach a scope.

schema.description: The surface catalog.
